title: Steering vector stability across random seeds and decoding temperature

original_idea.body: Fix a safety steering vector and measure its behavioral effect across many seeds and temperatures on a held-out eval, computing confidence intervals and recommending a minimum-runs protocol.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Rigor standard for steering claims plausibly reduces false-positive safety tooling, but impact chain to catastrophic-risk reduction skips a step.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Pure seed/temperature sweep with held-out eval; standard tools, single GPU, accessible to beginners.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped single measurement experiment with clear success criteria.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Doable externally but a methodology paper labs could also produce; moderate neglect.

novelty.reasoning: Variance reporting exists but this specific protocol may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: A dedicated seed/temperature stability protocol may be open.
